We ranked all 30.</description><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:58:32 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1013/261014_nba_now-or-later-rankings_16x9_608x342.jpg" /></item><item><title>Wemby, Spurs have 'clarity' after Finals loss but know 'nothing is guaranteed'</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50174585/san-antonio-spurs-wembanyama-expectations-nba</link><description>The Spurs enter the season with expectations to return to the Finals after their loss to the Knicks.</description><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:48:09 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1014/r1730175_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Walker Kessler impresses in preseason debut for Lakers</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50179763/walker-kessler-impresses-preseason-debut-lakers</link><description>Lakers center Walker Kessler made a strong first impression in his preseason debut Tuesday, finishing with 11 points on 4-for-6 shooting, nine rebounds, one block and one steal while playing only in the first half.</description><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 07:06:18 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1014/r1730520_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers: Game Highlights</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50179404/game-highlights</link><description>Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers: Game Highlights</description><pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 05:30:44 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/wsc/2026/1014/b18a238c-a623-4cbc-b023-2d0afb8d3e4b/b18a238c-a623-4cbc-b023-2d0afb8d3e4b.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
